info.title: FastSocial Instagram Data API
info.description: A read-only REST API for public Instagram data: profiles, posts, reels, stories, highlights, comments, likes, followers, hashtags, locations, audio and search, plus engagement insights and a handle check. One key, one header, clean JSON. Public data only; nothing logs in or posts.

tags.name: Posts & reels
tags.description: Timelines, reels, tagged posts, single posts and downloadable media.

tags.name: Engagement
tags.description: Comments, replies, likes and engagement insights.

get.description:
Follower, following and post counts, bio, links, category, verification and the HD profile picture of any public account.

Cost: **1 credit**.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Instagram handle, with or without @. A profile URL also works. Pass this or user_id.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Numeric Instagram user id. Pass this or username.

get.summary: Check if an Instagram handle exists and is public
get.description:
Does this handle exist, and is it public? States: ok, not_found, private, deactivated, memorialized, age_restricted, restricted_minor. Exact match only, so a typo never resolves to someone else.

Cost: **1 credit**.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Instagram handle, with or without @. A profile URL also works. Pass this or user_id.

get.summary: Get one Instagram post or reel
get.description:
Likes, comments, views, caption, owner and media URLs for a single post, reel or IGTV video.

Cost: **1 credit**.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Post, reel or IGTV URL. Pass this or shortcode.

parameters.name: shortcode
parameters.description: The code in the post URL (instagram.com/p/<code>/).

get.summary: Download URLs for a post, reel or carousel
get.description:
Direct image and video file URLs for every slide of a post, in the best quality available. URLs are signed Instagram CDN links that expire after a few hours.

Cost: **1 credit**.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Post, reel or IGTV URL. Pass this or shortcode.

parameters.name: shortcode
parameters.description: The code in the post URL (instagram.com/p/<code>/).
